Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Overview of the platform. Stats are cached on the server with `use cache` (cacheLife + cacheTag).

items.bff: BFF auth: tokens live only in httpOnly cookies, every request goes through /api/proxy
items.query: React Query wrapped by makeQuery / makeMutation with related-key invalidation
items.table: URL-synced search, filters, sorting and pagination (useTableState)
items.i18n: English + Persian with full RTL support
items.cache: Next.js Cache Components (`use cache`) + Redis for rate limiting and cache-aside
items.pwa: Installable PWA with an offline fallback
items.mocks: Fake upstream API with MSW + Faker (no backend needed)
